title: A column is cross-filtered, not filtered, by a filter on another column of its table

source.quote: With a table argument, ISFILTERED returns TRUE if any column -- of the table has a direct filter.
source.supports: the page shows this query for a filter on Sales[Unit Price] with these four results

derivation: The filter is on Sales[Amount]. Sales[Quantity] has no filter of its own (FALSE) but is in the same table as a filtered column (cross-filtered, TRUE). ISFILTERED ( Sales ) is TRUE because one of its columns is filtered.
